parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $('Get All Leaves').all().map(i => i.json).filter(r => r && r.request_id);
rows.sort((a, b) => String(b.submitted_at || '').localeCompare(String(a.submitted_at || '')));
return rows.map(r => ({ json: {
  'Request ID': r.request_id,
  'Month': String(r.leave_date || '').slice(0, 7),
  'Employee ID': r.employee_id,
  'Employee Name': r.employee_name,
  'Employee Email': r.employee_email,
  'Leave Date': r.leave_date,
  'Day Type': r.day_type,
  'Days': r.leave_days,
  'Reason': r.reason,
  'Status': r.status,
  'Decision Type': r.decision_type || 'Standard',
  'Approved Days Before': r.leaves_used_before,
  'Escalated': r.escalated ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  'HR Decision': r.hr_decision,
  'Director Decision': r.director_decision,
  'Submitted At': r.submitted_at,
  'Decided At': r.decided_at || '',
} }));
